clause: Conditional (if/else) action + deterministic side-effect-scoped eval + cycle-error [STU-PRO-026]

scope.summary: Implement the conditional action: evaluate a boolean expression over StudioVariables and branch into distinct action lists; conditionals and multiple chained actions compose so one trigger runs a small runtime program. Expression evaluation MUST be deterministic and side-effect-scoped to variables and navigation, and expression/alias cycles are validation errors (MT-351). The conditional editor is an operator surface.
acceptance_criteria: if/else conditional over variables, deterministic + side-effect-scoped, cycles are validation errors; author_id + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: conditional (if/else) editor reachable via author_id
live: boolean expression branches into distinct action lists; deterministic + side-effect-scoped; expression/alias cycle is a validation error

risk_if_missed: No conditionals; branching runtime logic impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
